# Dependencies (`deps/`)

This directory contains pre-compiled runtime binaries used for DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in VR:

- **`cudart64_12.dll`**: NVIDIA CUDA 12.x Runtime DLL required dynamically by `nvngx_dlssnr.dll`.
- **`renodx-dlss5.addon64`**: RenoDX DLSS 5 add-on providing the neural reconstruction pipeline and continuous evaluation hooks.
